condition: Passing an argument that isn't the expected Arrow wrapper type crashes the interpreter with a segfault instead of raising TypeError. Affected calls: ParquetReadOptions(binary_type=...), SparseCOOTensor.from_tensor, substrait.serialize_schema / serialize_expressions, IndexOptions(...).serialize and a
workaround: Pass only the documented types: a pa.DataType or None for binary_type, a pa.Tensor, a pa.Schema, a pa.Scalar for IndexOptions, and Declaration objects for from_sequence. Check the type with isinstance before calling.
